About the Brand

More Than Clothing.
A Statement.

NELO House of Fashion is more than just clothing. It is confidence, beauty, and self-expression. The brand was created from a deep passion for designing pieces that make men and women feel elegant and unforgettable.

What started as a love for fashion gradually grew into a journey of creating custom outfits for men, women and children who want to stand out and feel special in every moment.

Every design is made with attention to detail, creativity, and care. From luxury dresses and bridal gowns to tailored suits, senator styles and occasion wear, each piece is crafted to bring out confidence and beauty in the person wearing it.

Founded by Chinelo Chukwurah, NHF has grown beyond just making clothes. It has become a growing fashion identity known for stylish craftsmanship, unique designs, and timeless elegance. With clients from different countries and participation in fashion events, the vision continues to expand while staying true to quality and originality.

This is fashion made to be remembered.

What We Offer

Our Craft, Your Vision

From intimate bridal fittings to polished everyday staples. Every service at NHF is delivered with the same obsessive attention to detail.

01 💍

Bridal & Wedding

Your wedding day deserves nothing less than perfection. We craft bridal gowns, bridesmaids' dresses, and complete wedding-party looks, each made to your exact measurements and vision.

Enquire →

Men's Wear

Sharp, intentional, and crafted with the same care as every women's piece. Native wear, casual outfits, formal looks and more, made for the man who takes pride in how he presents himself, wherever he is in the world.

Enquire
02 💼

Corporate & Office Wear

Dress the part and command every room. Tailored suits, power dresses, blazers, and executive ensembles designed for the modern Nigerian professional who refuses to blend in.

Enquire →
03 🪡

Traditional & Native Wear

Celebrate your heritage in its full glory. From Isi Agu and George wrappers to Aso-oke and Ankara. We bring colour, culture, and couture together in every piece we create.

04 ✨

Casual & Everyday Wear

Elegance isn't reserved for special occasions. We design casual pieces, co-ords, and everyday staples that keep you looking effortlessly polished, from Monday mornings to Saturday evenings.
